title: The Gilded Spire Again
author: Odile Ishikawa
blurb: Dominic Whitlock, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
